terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Please read these terms before you subscribe. By confirming a Smart Play subscription you agree to them.
terms.about.title: 1. The service
terms.about.body: Smart Play is a subscription service for ATOM mobile customers. One subscription gives you access to QuizPro, SpeakEasy and PlayVerse.
terms.packages.title: 2. Packages and charges
terms.packages.body: Daily package: {daily} per day. 3 Days package: {threeDay} every 3 days. Prices include tax and are charged to your ATOM balance.
terms.free.title: 3. Free access period
terms.free.body: Each package includes the free access period shown when you subscribe: 1 day for Daily and 3 days for 3 Days.
terms.renew.title: 4. Automatic renewal
terms.renew.body: Your subscription renews automatically at the end of each period until you cancel. If your balance is too low, the renewal may be retried later and your access paused until it succeeds.
terms.cancel.title: 5. How to cancel
terms.cancel.body: Dial {cancelCode} or use the Unsubscribe page at any time. You will not be charged again after cancelling. Charges already made are not refunded.
terms.data.title: 6. Mobile data
terms.data.body: Subscribing requires ATOM mobile data. Using the apps uses mobile data, and standard data charges may apply.
terms.eligibility.title: 7. Who can subscribe
terms.eligibility.body: You must be an ATOM customer and the owner of the number, or have the owner's permission. Users under 18 need permission from a parent or guardian.
terms.content.title: 8. Content
terms.content.body: Games and content are provided by Smart Play and its partners. Titles may be added, changed or removed at any time.
terms.changes.title: 9. Changes to these terms
terms.changes.body: We may update these terms. The latest version is always on this page. If you keep using the service after a change, you accept the updated terms.
terms.contact.title: 10. Contact
terms.contact.body: For questions about your subscription or charges, please contact Smart Play customer support.
